name: s2-long-list
note: Accessibility settings: a long list, four slow swipes reach the end of the list (the page is still settling when the first swipe lands, so mid-list positions drift a little; the end does not), then the last item. The all-apps list was tried first: it shows only 9 apps on this image and does not scroll. A bare word target is read as a class-name selector (NOT_FOUND), hence :has-text.
